module_summary: Byte-pair phase tracker: a toggle flop alternates on each strobe and the first (even-phase) byte of each pair is latched into a holding register.

anchors.name: odd_q
anchors.why: Two-state even/odd phase toggled on each strobe; gates byte capture.

anchors.name: hi_byte
anchors.why: Latches bus byte on even-phase strobe, held through the pair.

anchors.name: stb
anchors.why: Input data strobe; toggles phase and qualifies capture.

anchors.name: bus_i
anchors.why: Incoming byte bus captured into holding register.

anchors.name: grab_w
anchors.why: Capture enable: strobe in even phase loads hi_byte.

groups.name: phase_capture
groups.description: Phase toggle and capture enable latch first byte of each strobed pair.
